verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for an observability platform, but nothing in the evidence documents a scheduler for user-defined recurring jobs or workflows. Synthetic monitoring (elastic-docs-5) and threshold alert rules (elastic-docs-16) are related features, and neither is described as a user-configurable recurring schedule, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
